expectations.text: Identifies full RAM as the cost driver
expectations.evidence: 'The $600k annual figure is what the deployment costs with full-resolution vectors sitting in RAM and no quantization.' Breaks down 2.8TB raw + HNSW overhead.

expectations.text: Recommends scalar quantization as first step
expectations.evidence: Option 1 is scalar quantization. Formula shows 4x reduction.

expectations.text: Mentions mmap storage as cost reduction lever
expectations.evidence: References mmap for storing full vectors on disk while quantized stay in RAM.

expectations.text: Mentions FDE or premium support can be removed
expectations.evidence: 'First thing to check: does the proposal include an FDE or Premium Support tier? removing those line items alone could drop the price by $200k+'

expectations.text: Provides concrete cost estimate or formula
expectations.evidence: Full formula: RAM units = ceil(total/8), $53/unit/month. Calculates 533 units = $28k/month baseline. Shows optimized scenarios.

expectations.text: Does NOT dismiss the customer's concern
expectations.evidence: Opens with 'Yes, you can get into the $150-200k/year range.' Validates the concern.
